risk_note: RV2 (notification SMS / site-auth alert / push send, app.module wiring). D10-316 ①, D10-337 ②, D10-339 ⑥: SMS sign name and template code come from the notify_templates in-use registration by code (SMS_CODE falls back to the deployment SMS_SIGN_NAME / SMS_TEMPLATE_VERIFY_CODE when unregistered; other codes are not sent unless registered and switched on; pending test registrations are never used; codes whose default channels include SMS but are not ready are logged, not sent). The site-auth alert goes through the live Aliyun sender in staging / prod with full SMS config (local / test keep the fake) and writes the BizId to notify_logs.sms_biz_id after acceptance; same accepted / rejected / unknown mapping and no resend as B1-12w. Push is skipped for codes whose channels lack push, the inbox is still written. No money, no attribution, no migration.
